what.text: This page follows refugees from Senegal living in the Gambia, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 3850 Senegalese refugees in the Gambia, 29.6% of all refugees from Senegal.
France hosts the most Senegalese refugees, followed by the Gambia, Canada and Italy.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Casamance territory in Senegal in periods from 1990 to 2011, with the MFDC.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2006 to 2017.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1992 at 3294 refugees and fell to a low in 2003.
The figure was at its highest, 11036, at the end of 2014, and was lower by 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the Gambia.
These are year-end totals for the Gambia only, reported to UNHCR.
